# Incident INC-2828: Catalog indexing

**Severity:** SEV2 · **Started:** 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z · **Resolved:** 2026-10-10T08:57:00Z · **Duration:** 2 hours

## Summary

Between 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z and 2026-10-10T08:57:00Z, requests to `catalog-api` on port `3000` failed with HTTP 504.
The on-call engineer was paged after 5 minutes.

## Impact

- 3 users affected (~11% of traffic)
- 450 requests per second were rejected
- Estimated revenue impact: $98000

## Timeline

| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z | Alert fired: `HighErrorRate` on `catalog-api` |
| 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z | On-call acknowledged the page |
| 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z | Root cause identified: a schema migration locked a hot table for longer than the timeout |
| 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z | Mitigation applied: rolled back the deploy and raised the pool limit |
| 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z | Recovery confirmed, alerts silenced |

## Root cause

a schema migration locked a hot table for longer than the timeout

The deploy at 2026-10-12T09:36:52.313Z increased the connection pool from 50 to 250, which
exceeded the database limit of 100.

## Action items

- [ ] Add a pool-size alert below 70% saturation (owner: sre)
- [ ] Add a load test that reproduces the saturation point (owner: payments)

| 2026-10-19T09:01:02.720Z | Mitigation applied: terminated the stuck queries and shed load |
| 2026-10-19T09:01:02.720Z | Recovery confirmed, alerts silenced |

## Root cause

a schema migration locked a hot table for longer than the timeout

The deploy at 2026-10-19T09:01:02.720Z increased the connection pool from 5 to 60, which
exceeded the database limit of 50.
